title: Savills Executive Nomad Index 2025
method: Savills ranked 30 destinations on internet speed, air connectivity, climate stability, prime residential prices and quality of life (page names only 14 with ranks; those are recorded).

title: 10 Best Cities for Digital Nomads 2025
method: Scored on country happiness score, cost of living, US State Dept advisories, things to do and safety index; all cities have a nomad visa.

title: Best cities for digital nomads in 2025 (Flatio)
method: Flatio ranked the top 20 on cost of living, internet speed and quality of life; weighting not described.

title: Top 100 digital nomad destinations 2025
method: Weighted score over 1,370 locations (affordability, safety, quality of life, infrastructure, return rates, social media presence) from Nomad List, Numbeo, Instagram; article shows only the top 10 of 100.

title: Nomads.com city list ranked by people going
method: Live homepage city list sorted by number of nomads 'going' to each city (page does not label the measure); top 24 cities captured 2026-10-15.

title: Hottest digital nomad destinations of 2025 (ScoutLogic)
method: ScoutLogic study of cost of living, connectivity, culture, healthcare, environment and local nomad community engagement.

title: The 25 Best Cities for Digital Nomads 2025
method: Editorial ranking weighing internet speed, safety, coworking, cost, nomad community/events and visa access.

title: Best places to be a digital nomad 2025 (Instant Offices)
method: Instant Offices scored cities on connectivity, affordability and weather; Time Out reports only the top 5 (Dubai scored 52.11).
